        group_id=group_id,
        access_token=splitwise_token,
        min_created_at='2023-05-19',
        max_created_at='2023-05-19',
        page_index=0,
        page_limit=20
    )

        expenses_page = apis.splitwise.show_group_expenses(
            group_id=group_id,
            access_token=splitwise_token,
            min_created_at='2023-05-19',
            max_created_at='2023-05-19',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20
        )
        all_expenses.extend(expenses_page)
        if len(expenses_page) < 20:
